Recent public listings on professional networks highlight a variety of private-sector employment opportunities across multiple regions and industries in India. Job seekers tracking the market can find roles spanning digital marketing, content writing, technical development, administrative support, and education.

Overview of Available Roles and Employers

The listings feature several specific employers and positions located across different Indian cities and states:

  • Content Writer: The Aspiring CEO Pvt. Ltd. (Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh)
  • Junior SEO Executives: NFlow Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Ahmedabad, Gujarat)
  • Junior SEO Executive: Digital Gratified FZ-LLC (India location details not fully specified)
  • SEO Executive: Nadcab Labs (Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh), Xira Infotech (Vapi, Gujarat), Alightway Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh), Kumbh Design Inc. (Ahmedabad, Gujarat), and others.
  • Video Editor: EazyGrad (New Delhi, Delhi) and Alienkind (Bengaluru, Karnataka)
  • Shopify Search Engine Optimization Executive: Brand It Up (Mohali district) and DocIndia.org (Gurugram, Haryana - noting fresher candidate requirements from Delhi NCR only)
  • Data Labeling Associate: Human Archive (YC W26) (Bengaluru, Karnataka)
  • Field Officer, Content & Brand Lead, City Head, and Elder Care Attendant: EzyHelpers (Multiple locations including Bengaluru, Bareilly, and Delhi)
  • HR & Customer Support Associate: FreeElective India
  • QC Officer: PACKYARD labels & packaging (Kochi, Kerala)
  • Collection Executive: Enerjazz (YC S21) (Faridabad, Ghaziabad, Noida)
  • E-Commerce Specialist: IGNITEXFUEL (Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh - Hybrid, Full-Time)
  • Junior Research Associate: NeoRecruit (Trivandrum, Kerala)
  • Full Stack Engineer & Quality Analyst: E11EVEN TECHNOLOGIES (Ahmedabad, Gujarat)
  • AI-First SEO Executive: Centena Group (Kochi, Kerala)
  • SEO Executive Assistant: Perfect Clicks LLC (Jaipur, Rajasthan - specifying human content only, no AI writing)
  • Benefits Specialist I: Dayforce India
  • Operations Executive (UK Timezone - Malayalam Speaking): EduMetrix Limited (Kozirkode, Kerala)
  • NEET Science Instructor (Grade 8 Foundation): Chaosology (Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu)
  • Public Relations Executive: Kritical Edge Consulting Pvt Ltd (New Delhi, Delhi)
  • K-12 Proofreader (Science): Cure Organics (Noida, Uttar Pradesh)
  • Trainee/Content Editor: The New Indian Express (Chennai, Tamil Nadu)

Practical Implications and Analysis

For applicants navigating these postings, understanding what information is confirmed versus what remains unstated is essential for managing expectations.

  • Employer: Confirmed for each individual listing as named above (e.g., The Aspiring CEO Pvt. Ltd., EzyHelpers, IGNITEXFUEL).
  • Role: Specific titles are provided for each opening, ranging from technical SEO and software roles to instructional and operational positions.
  • Location: Generally specified down to specific cities and states across India, with some roles noting regional constraints such as "Candidates from Delhi NCR only."
  • Eligibility: Specific educational qualifications, prior years of experience, or technical proficiencies are largely not specified in the summary text, though some roles mention fresher eligibility or specific language skills (e.g., Malayalam speaking).
  • Salary: Not specified across all listed positions.
  • Deadline: Not specified in the provided data.
  • Selection Process: Not specified in the source text.
  • Application Steps: Candidates typically need to sign in to professional networking platforms to apply or mark themselves as early applicants.
  • Official Application Link: Readers can view the original listings directly on LinkedIn India.
